title: Commit synthesis captures metadata-only decisions from grounding-regeneration and merge commits (e.g. dec_da03a8a00e 'Update Hunch decision count metadata after main merge')
observation: Observed 2026-09-15 on the hunch repo. The post-commit/post-merge synthesis produced dec_da03a8a00e, titled 'Update Hunch decision count metadata after main merge', from a commit whose only content was the regenerated grounding block (decision counts in CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/hunch.mdc, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .windsurf/rules/hunch.md). Earlier the same day the same path produced captures from release-pin bumps and rebased merges (dec_24c099b0c7 on the 1.38.0 release commit, dec_30ddff7308 on a rebase). None of these records a choice; they restate the diff. They inflate the decision count that the grounding block advertises, add provenance-repair escalations when the underlying commits are squash-merged, and cost a review each. Candidate rule: skip synthesis when the commit's changed files are only grounding-block outputs, .hunch/** captures, version pins (package.json/server.json/plugin/.mcp.json/.windsurf/hooks.json/package-lock.json) or a merge commit; or mark such captures as drafts that never regenerate grounding counts. The noise record was not landed (PR #259 closed); it exists only on an unpushed local commit.
